user.title: Set up iCSee Feeder
user.description: Connect to the feeder on your local network. Most iCSee/XMEye feeders use TCP port 34567.

data_description.host: IP address or DNS name of the feeder.
data_description.port: Local DVRIP/Sofia port. Leave as 34567 unless your feeder uses a custom port.
data_description.default_servings: How many portions the Feed button dispenses by default.
data_description.rtsp_port: Camera RTSP port. Most iCSee/XMEye devices use 554.
data_description.rtsp_channel: Camera channel. Most single-camera feeders use 1.
data_description.rtsp_stream: 0 is the high-resolution main stream. 1 is the lower-resolution substream and is usually better for dashboards.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the feeder.
error.not_feeder: The device responded, but its firmware does not report feeder support.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Dispense food from an iCSee/XMEye feeder.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Number of portions to dispense. If omitted, the integration uses the Portions entity value.

add_scheduled_feed.name: Add scheduled feed
add_scheduled_feed.description: Add a scheduled feed entry to the feeder firmware.

time.name: Time
time.description: Local time for the feeder to dispense food.

delete_scheduled_feed.name: Delete scheduled feed
delete_scheduled_feed.description: Delete scheduled feed entries from the feeder firmware.

time.name: Time
time.description: Local scheduled feed time to remove.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Optional portion count used to narrow the schedule entries removed.
